migration_objective: Provision ML-DSA keys for custody actors and update public-key distribution.
preconditions: Shipment actors and package records are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Only the current holder may transfer custody.
Sequence links and signatures detect modified or missing events.
migration_requirements: Use standardized ML-DSA with a ShipmentProof context string.
Update stored signature and public-key encodings.
Preserve append-only event ordering and fail closed.
verification_procedure: Run original and PQC suites separately.
Test authorized/unauthorized handoff, valid chain, tampering, wrong key, serialization, and malformed fields.
known_limitations: This simulation does not establish legal chain-of-custody certification.
